title: A border you add to an ellipse follows the ellipse
goal: Draw an ellipse, add a Border in Effects, and you get a black rectangle round it instead of a ring following the oval. Any shape you add a border to should get a border shaped like that shape.
notes: Reproduced on the probe on 2026-09-08 while working the outline task. Command: Scripts/playtest.sh with a walk that draws an ellipse with O, switches its Outline off, adds a Border from the Effects plus and widens it. Output: /tmp/photonz-playtest/outline-repro/3-canvas-ellipse-border.png shows a red ellipse inside a black SQUARE ring. The cause is DocumentRenderer.ringed (Sources/PhotonzRender/DocumentRenderer.swift, around line 1000), which builds every ring out of roundedRectImage over the layer box, so the shape of the layer never enters into it. Sources/PhotonzCore/OutlineWidth.swift already calls this out in words: on an ellipse, a line or an arrow the border draws a RECTANGLE round the bounding box, which is an accident of how it is painted rather than something anyone reaches for. This BLOCKS retiring the Appearance outline (see the task outline-leaves-appearance-and-an-effect-s-colour): a shape edge cannot be drawn only by added borders while an added border cannot follow a shape. A line and an arrow are a separate question and are not in this scope: their stroke IS the layer, and a ring round a stroke is a different idea.
acceptance: A border added to an ellipse draws an oval ring that follows the ellipse, inside, centred and outside
A border added to a rectangle is unchanged, at every corner radius
A border on a picture, a frame, a label or a group is unchanged: those have no path of their own, so they keep the ring round their box
Two borders on one ellipse both follow it, and the one nearer the top of the list still paints over the other
A test in PhotonzRender covers an ellipse with a border, written before the change
Audit written under queue/audits/ with an ellipse carrying an inside border and an outside one
